name: Moneyview Limited (Whizdm Innovations Limited)
industry: Fintech / Digital lending & financial services platform
description: We are a consumer-focused, digital only, credit-led financial services platform for Middle India (households with an average annual income of ₹300,000– ₹1,100,000) customers providing access to a full suite of financial products through a network of Financial Partners, including our NBFC subsidiary, on our Moneyview mobile application. Personal loans are our flagship offering, personalized through our in-house AI/ML segmentation and risk models. We operate as a lending service provider, facilitating loan origination and servicing.

objects.purpose: Investment to drive growth in loan disbursals under default loss guarantee (DLG) arrangements
Investment in WFPL, our Material Subsidiary, for the purpose of augmenting its capital base
